name: chat-sanity (create a conversation, one turn via awaitTurn)
notes: New chat opens a conversation at once (routes/Chat.svelte, startConversation); the picker shows only when create_chat_session fails. The question is therefore sent from the composer of the conversation that opened. chat-plan-mode-chip is awaited before the send because the header renders it only once the detail of the conversation is loaded (ChatConversationHeader.svelte, {#if session}), which is also when the conversation is pushed into currentSession, the store awaitTurn reads the session id from.
The model of a seeded run reasons before it answers: awaitTurn carries its own deadline, and the answer is captured, not asserted on its wording.
